# Obsolete Rust scaffold removed

The unimplemented `rust_kernel_scaffold` target from v0.42 was removed from the
v0.50.1 source-audited branch. It printed a placeholder message and contained no
authority logic. The maintained native target is `rust_authority_kernel_v44`,
with `rust_authority_kernel` retained only as historical v0.43 lineage source.
Neither Rust target is represented as compiled in this environment.
